name: 逗逗
evolution: 逗逗 → 气球猫 Lv.20 → 梦想三三 Lv.32 → 奇梦咪
evolutionEn: Doudou → Qiqiumao Lv.20 → Mengxiangsansan Lv.32 → Qimengmi
description: 体内充满轻质气体，骨骼与肌肉结构都很轻，因此可以在空中漂浮活动。它通过换气调节气体量与分布，来控制自己上浮或下沉。
descriptionEn: Its body is filled with light gas, and its skeletal and muscular structures are both very light, allowing it to float and move through the air. It regulates the amount and distribution of gas through breathing to control its rising and sinking.

skills.name: 示弱
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：速度永久+150。

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 飞吻
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy sprite.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; gains Fairyfication: this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 甜心续航
skills.description: 自己和敌方获得萌化：回复40%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Fairyfication for self and enemy: recovers 40% HP.

skills.name: 撒娇
skills.description: 造成魔伤，3连击。自己获得萌化：威力永久+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 3 hits. Gains Fairyfication: power permanently +20.

skills.name: 反弹
skills.description: 将自己的萌化转移给敌方。
skills.descriptionEn: Transfers own Fairyfication to the enemy.

skills.name: 防反
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：自己获得物攻和魔攻+70%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; against attacks: gains ATK and MATK +70%.

skills.name: 破罐破摔
skills.description: 造成魔伤，自己有减益时，本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; if self has a debuff, this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels own debuffs; doubles own buffs.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1 hit; for each layer of Fairyfication on all sprites carried by both sides, this skill's hit count +1.

skills.name: 赤子之心
skills.description: 自己获得萌化：全技能能耗永久-3。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Fairyfication: all-skill energy cost permanently -3.

skills.name: 吨位压制
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方体重越低，威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the lower the enemy's weight, the higher the power.

skills.name: 应激反应
skills.description: 自己回复25%生命，应对防御：改为回复50%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Recovers 25% HP; against Defense: recovers 50% HP instead.
